name: Clemens Kaserer
title: Manager · Cloud Engineering at Avanade
tagline: Cloud Engineering Manager at Avanade. I lead Azure platform teams and pair AI-augmented delivery (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) with rigorous standardization — most recently shipping a project at 3.2× the speed of a traditional, non-AI delivery.
summary: Manager for Cloud Engineering at Avanade with a decade of hands-on Azure experience. I work across three strengths: leading and growing cloud engineering teams; designing Azure platforms — Landing Zones via the Cloud Adoption Framework (including Sovereign Landing Zones), AKS and OpenShift, Functions and Web Apps — with standardization and automation as the foundation; and embedding AI-augmented engineering into delivery. As one of the people responsible at Avanade for the GitHub Copilot rollout (compliance, licensing, enablement), I make AI tooling production-safe for enterprise teams. The most recent project I led delivered at roughly 3.2× the speed of a comparable traditional, non-AI engagement.
